Serious safety incident
I was drugged with a spiked drink at this bar, resulting in severe financial and physical harm.
Sep 2025 • Solo
FOR ALL VISITORS TO BUI VIEN WALKING STREET AND CRAZY NIGHT BAR - A MUST-READ REGARDING A SERIOUS SCAM ON SEPTEMBER 21 THAT CAUSED SIGNIFICANT FINANCIAL AND HEALTH DAMAGE -
 
A WARNING ABOUT CRAZY NIGHT BAR ON BUI VIEN WALKING STREET, HO CHI MINH CITY
 
This is a warning about a shocking scam I experienced at Crazy Night Bar on Bui Vien Walking Street in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In the early morning hours of September 21, 2025, I was drugged with a spiked drink at this bar, resulting in severe financial and physical harm.
 
What Happened
 
I arrived at Crazy Night Bar around 5 a.m. and ordered a cocktail. After just one sip, I became completely disoriented. Having experienced spiked drinks twice before, I was certain that my drink had been drugged.
From that moment on, I have no memory of what happened. CCTV footage from the police station revealed that the bar staff surrounded me, took my credit card, and charged it dozens of times over a period of about four hours, totaling 28,000,000 VND (approximately $1,100 USD). The footage shows me staggering, barely conscious, while the staff repeatedly forced me to drink and took away any unfinished drinks.

The Bar's False Claims vs. Clear Evidence

The bar staff claimed I was buying drinks for their female employees, but this bar is not a "hostess bar," and I have never bought drinks for their staff on previous visits.
The $1,100 charged would be enough for 163 cocktails, but the CCTV footage shows only about 10 glasses on my table.
During the police investigation, the officer reviewed the CCTV and the fraudulent receipts with no signature. He instructed the bar to immediately refund 25,000,000 VND, but even after a week, I have not received the money back.
 
Health and Mental Trauma
 
Beyond the financial loss, the effects of being drugged and wandering for hours have caused severe physical and psychological trauma. I am currently suffering from body tremors, vomiting, insomnia, and nightmares. This incident has taken a massive toll on my health.
 
My Next Steps
 
To prevent others from falling victim to this dangerous scam, I am taking the following actions:
I will share my experience on all major travel websites, communities, and social media platforms worldwide.
I will report this incident to news outlets in both South Korea and Vietnam to raise public awareness.
I will file a formal complaint with the Consulate General of the Republic of Korea in Ho Chi Minh City and send official notices to all resident diplomats.
I will hire a lawyer to file a lawsuit against the bar and pursue all available legal options.
Please be aware of the serious dangers of Bui Vien Walking Street, especially Crazy Night Bar. If you plan to visit, be extremely careful and under no circumstances accept drinks from strangers or even bar staff.
